title: Games with Motion controls
author: SnooDonuts493
selftext:
I put in 2-3 hours after work. So it was slow. About 2 months start to finish.

Stack was basically Claude (just the Pro subscription) for the code and Higgsfield for the art and video. Honestly the video quality surprised me the most, I did not expect it to come out looking like this.

The game is called Inferno Drop. You open your mouth to breathe fire and sweep your head to aim, and you hold the line until the rescue ship shows up. It runs in the browser off your webcam, no install, no controller. There is a keyboard/touch mode too if you would rather not make faces at your laptop.

It came out better than I expected. It is free, and the whole site is free, no paywall, no signup needed to play. There are 9 other motion games on there too if you want to mess around.

https://motionarcade.app/games

Would really appreciate any feedback, on the game or the video. Please let me know what you think
